Claims Department

Re: Claim C-1158
Our client: Olivia Butler
Date of loss: 10/20/2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the claim you have opened under the reference
assigned to this matter. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, recorded
interviews, medical authorizations, and settlement discussions, to this office and not to our client. If your insured or any
representative contacts our client directly, please let us know promptly.
Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is currently receiving treatment. We ask that you provide a certified copy of the
declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss, along with the bodily injury and property damage limits applicable to
this claim, and confirm whehter any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.
We also request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and
event recorder information, photographs, repair estimates and the vehicle itself where it remains available, dash camera footage,
claim notes, adjuster communications, and any recorded statements. Please suspned any routine deletion or disposal of such
material until this matter is resolved.
Sincerely,
James Cooke
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
